custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an untracked part, part A, with 3 in one bin location, bin location A.
  • Have a tracked part, part B, with 4 on hand, so the lookup rows can be compared.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Create an open purchase order for this test, purchase order A.
  • Start on purchase order A.

Setup

  1. Make part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C839433 PART A; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839433-A; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Quantity (in the bin row): 3. Click Track quantities and cost of goods off. Click Save.
  2. Make part B: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C839433 PART B; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839433-B; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Quantity (in the bin row): 4. Click Save.
  3. The part numbers above both start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839433-.
  4. Click Parts in the top bar, Purchase Orders in the left menu, then New PO; pick any Vendor, type any existing part number in Part Number and pick it, type 1 in Quantity, click Add, then Save & Close. A purchase order made this way has no work order, so its page shows the Add Order Item button.
